changelog: - **Phone: selecting something no longer puts More and the canvas buttons out of reach.** On a phone, a tap on a node or a connection used to bring the whole read-only Inspector sheet up by itself. Its dimmed backdrop lay over the More button, and the sheet over Zoom in, Zoom out and Reset view: More took two taps and the first one cleared the selection, and the canvas could not be zoomed or fitted while something was selected. A selection now brings a small panel of one row above the run bar, with nothing dimmed: the name, the kind and, for a Pool or a Parameter, its current amount or its value. A connection is named by its two ends, with its kind and its Flow; several selected nodes by their number. More opens with one tap and the selection stays; the canvas buttons stand just above the panel. Details opens the read-only sheet, and closing the sheet comes back to the panel with the selection kept. Deselect, a tap on the empty canvas or Reset view takes the selection off. Selecting does not move the canvas, so on a phone held sideways a node low on the screen can be partly under the panel; the canvas can be moved with the panel up. Only a tapped node that the panel would cover completely is brought up, by just enough to show above it, with the zoom and the sideways position kept. The tour’s Inspect step says the new order in all 18 languages.
